items.summary: Elevance Health said it continues to expect full year 2026 shareholders' earnings of at least $22.00 per diluted share, including approximately $7.00 per diluted share of net unfavorable items, and adjusted shareholders' earnings of at least $29.00 per diluted share. The company also reaffirmed its full year 2026 benefit expense ratio guidance of 90.2% plus or minus 50 basis points.
items.title: Elevance Health reaffirms 2026 earnings guidance at investor meetings

items.summary: Steel Dynamics announced a $3.0 billion share repurchase authorization on November 9, 2026, adding to a previous $1.5 billion program with $216 million remaining as of September 30, 2026. The company also declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.53 per common share payable in January 2027. Since 2017, Steel Dynamics has repurchased $8.2 billion of common stock representing 45 percent of outstanding shares.
items.title: Steel Dynamics authorizes additional $3.0 billion share repurchase program

items.summary: The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers rose 0.4% on a seasonally adjusted basis in October, down from 0.6% in September. Shelter accounted for over thirty percent of the monthly increase, rising 0.3%, while energy increased 0.7% and food rose 0.5%. The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3%, matching the increases in September and August.
items.title: Consumer Price Index increases 0.4% in October; shelter drives gains

items.summary: TransDigm reported fourth quarter net sales of $2,988 million, up 23% from $2,437 million a year earlier, with earnings per share of $10.33, up 33% from $7.75. For the full fiscal 2026 year, net sales increased 20% to $10,557 million from $8,831 million, and the company raised fiscal 2027 guidance with expected net sales of $11,950 million to $12,150 million and earnings per share of $42.06 to $42.91, up 20% at the midpoint.
items.title: TransDigm Group reports fiscal 2026 fourth quarter and full year results

items.summary: Venture Global reported third-quarter revenue of $4.8 billion, up 43% from Q3 2025, with net income of $2.5 billion, up 493% from the prior year. The company raised its full-year 2026 Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $10.0–$10.3 billion from $8.7–$9.1 billion, and commenced commercial operations at its Plaquemines Phase 1 project on October 31, 2026. Venture Global also announced frame agreements with GE Vernova and Baker Hughes for up to 16 new 720 MW power islands to support potential data center infrastructure expansion.
items.title: Venture Global reports record Q3 2026 results and raises full-year guidance

items.summary: Duke Energy Corporation and six subsidiaries amended their credit agreement on November 9, 2026, obtaining lender consent for an internal reorganization. On January 1, 2027, Duke Energy Progress will merge into Duke Energy Carolinas, with Duke Energy Carolinas as the surviving entity.
items.title: Duke Energy amends credit agreement ahead of subsidiary merger

items.summary: MetLife Inc and its subsidiary MetLife Funding Inc amended and restated their credit agreement on November 9, 2026, providing for committed borrowings and letters of credit up to $4 billion, with an option to increase to $5.5 billion. The facility matures on November 7, 2031, with letters of credit permitted to remain outstanding until November 7, 2032. The agreement is for general corporate purposes.
items.title: MetLife amends and restates $4 billion credit agreement

items.summary: American Tower priced a registered public offering of $450M senior unsecured notes due 2031 at 5.300%, $500M due 2033 at 5.560%, and $550M due 2036 at 5.750%, for net proceeds of $1,474.9M after expenses. The company said it intends to use the net proceeds to repay indebtedness under its $6.0B revolving credit facility and for general corporate purposes.
items.title: American Tower prices $1.5B senior notes offering across three maturities

items.summary: Nike appointed Dan McKenzie, 55, as Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer, Finance Operations & Transformation and principal accounting officer effective November 9, 2026. McKenzie, who retired from Nike in July 2026 after more than 19 years with the company, will receive an annual base salary of $500,000, a target bonus of 50% of eligible earnings, and an annual long-term incentive target of $525,000, plus one-time RSU awards valued at $600,000.
items.title: Nike appoints Dan McKenzie as Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer

items.summary: UnitedHealth Group appointed Madeline Bell as an independent director effective November 3, 2026. Bell is the former president and CEO of Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, where she spent four decades starting as a pediatric nurse in 1983 and serving as CEO from 2015 until her retirement last month.
items.title: UnitedHealth Group appoints Madeline Bell as independent director
